scope: Metadata header interpretation from saved controls; no library loaded or native code invoked. The earlier static library inspection was removed.

header_roles.namespace_uuid: Wide UUID read as the segment current version UUID
header_roles.header_words: One little-endian u64 saved software version; the controlled value decodes to the running Fusion build
header_roles.storage_word_second: Count of inherited segment version UUIDs, followed by that many UTF-16 UUID strings; zero in every qualified control

provenance: The magic value and the packed software version are confirmed by saved controls from a known Fusion build. The other field roles, the bit widths and the unused bits came from removed static inspection of installed Fusion libraries. They are not confirmed by a black-box experiment.
qualification: Current production framing admits only the observed zero-ancestry profile; this evidence does not qualify older metadata versions or nonempty ancestry runtime acceptance
